Messages.Author: M.Schumacher
Messages.Body:
I just need a quick confirmation on this.
If I use Warsaw Station to move a Nosi from Torpor to the ready region during my influence phase can I play Legendary Vampire on him in my next master phase if he is cap 7 or more?

Warsaw Station
Master: unique location.
You may tap this card when a Nosferatu announces an undirected action. If that action is successful, the acting Nosferatu untaps. You may burn this card (even if it is tapped) to move a Nosferatu in torpor to the ready region.

Legendary Vampire
Unique master.
Put this card on a vampire with a capacity above 6 who was moved into your ready region during your last influence phase. This vampire gets +2 bleed and an additional 2 votes. Any vampire may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: Nice loophole. I'd say yes, since you fulfill the requirements of the card, and because Legendary Vsmpire doesn't say from where the vampire needs to enter the ready region.

Messages.Author: GreyB
Messages.Body:
I'd say no.

> Legendary Vampire
> Unique master.
> Put this card on a vampire with a capacity above 6 who was moved into your ready region during your last influence phase. This vampire gets +2 bleed and an additional 2 votes. Any vampire may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.
>
Rescuing from torpor happens in minion phase, not influence phase.

-1 Strength
